sc: Coal is a resource that can be obtained through mining coal rocks or concentrated coal rocks, requiring level 20 Mining, in various places around RuneScape.
One of the best places to mine coal rocks is Gunnarsgrunn mine while concentrated coal is only found in the Living Rock Caverns.
The Coat of Clubs is a male-only torso slot cosmetic override that could be unlocked by purchasing the King and Queen of Clubs Pack.
It is made by giving Sir Tiffy Cashien a normal commorb.
Cooked undead pekin is made by cooking raw undead pekin on any range or fire.
It was given by speaking to Kristlin and asking for a cookie.
Cooking potions are made by mixing clean harralander and cooked swordfish in a vial of water, giving 125 Herblore experience.

sc: The key parts are untradeable, and thus must all be found by the same player.
It is obtained by upgrading the tier 70 variant with 2 pieces of greater ensouled cloth, 1 spool of greater ensouled thread, and 25 flesh runes after the completion of Kili's Knowledge VI.
Once 2,000 fragments had been obtained, they could be combined into the desert pantheon aura.
It is obtained in the Parts bin next to the Inventor's workbench and can be disassembled.
Dolorous Witch Top is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked through the Potion Pandemonium promotion on Treasure Hunter.
It allowed one account to transform into a non-player character of their choice (decided before the item is awarded) for two weeks, after which it was removed.
It can be crafted at level 46 Crafting, using 3 Dromomastyx hide, a thread, and a needle for 156.
It appears to be a snow globe, similar to the one the player receives as a reward from the 2007 Christmas event, which is given by the Queen of Snow during her first appearance.
It is obtained after repairing the broken fuse box on an anvil with a hammer.
A Farming XP lamp is a reward for having grown four Spirit trees at the same time, received from Glouron after having talked to the Spirit Tree in Prifddinas.
A fire talisman staff can be made by combining a fire talisman with a runecrafting staff.
Runecrafting staves are sold at the Runecrafting Guild by Wizard Elriss for 10,000 Runecrafting guild tokens or by Stanley Limelight for 330 thaler.
The Firebrand Bow is a cosmetic override available from Solomon's General Store.
It can be filled with 10 pages that can be obtained as drops from adamant and rune dragons.
It was made by combining a focus sight, hexcrest and slayer helmet (which had to be uncharged beforehand) by using one on any of the others.
The helm could hold a maximum of 20 ferocious ring charges and 40 ring of slaying charges, made by using the rings on the helmet and requiring 60 Crafting.
Once one shard per skill has been obtained, players can combine them to create a gatherer's cape, and a matching cosmetic hood.
The gatherer's cape can't be re-obtained from Diango if a keepsake key was used on it.
The glacial siren shield is a cosmetic override shield that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 36 of The Knight Before Christmas while having access to premier rewards.

sc: Gold Christmas Present is a possible reward from the 2021 Christmas event for handing in 200 pieces of Christmas wrapping paper at Postie Pete.
They can be obtained when gaining experience in Agility or Thieving if the Golden Touch relic is chosen, or from void shards.
The gorgonite knife is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
It is affiliated with Zamorak and is dropped by K'ril Tsutsaroth.
The green rectangle key is a key found in Daemonheim while training the Dungeoneering skill.
Only one green rectangle key can be found in a single dungeon.
A huge fallen star (Magic) is a rare prize from Treasure Hunter that can be redeemed for bonus experience in the Magic skill.
2× the experience given by a huge XP lamp.
It can be found in special bird's nests after having built a tier 3 Grove.
A single nest containing the next Imcando hatchet fragment in sequence can be obtained by talking to Oak after constructing the tier 3 building of Woodcutters' Grove at Fort Forinthry.
Ingression fragments can be obtained by killing monsters in the Heart of Gielinor.
Players cannot obtain any drops (excluding the fragments themselves) and will not obtain any killcount from reinforcements they have summoned themselves.
Keldagrim camouflage legs are an item that can be made with 3,600 camouflage fragments, previously it could be won from Treasure Hunter.
The king help book or King help is obtained within the wave 10 waiting room.
Like the queen help book, it is available in a bookcase of a player-owned house, but only after the player has defeated the Penance King.

sc: Large hydra lamp is a Treasure Hunter reward, obtained from the Hydra Lamps promotion.

Legacy Pernix Gloves.x: Legacy Pernix Gloves is a hands slot cosmetic override unlocked by equipping Pernix gloves. Your new item(s) can be found in the Customisations Interface.

sc: It is obtained by searching the goblin stove in a locked kitchen in the dungeon below the Observatory.
The cell can be unlocked with the key found in one of the many chests around.
The lucky dragon platebody is a piece of lucky equipment that could previously be won from Squeal of Fortune.
Malevolent energy is an item obtained when escaping the encounter of The Barrows: Rise of the Six alive.
Making the malevolent armour requires level 91-93 Smithing along with a certain number of energy and reinforcing plates, the latter bought from Saro in Keldagrim or Noterazzo at the Bandit Camp.
The mechanical spider leg 3 is found in the darker dimension during the 2016 Halloween event.
All 8 legs and 500 reward points can be exchanged for the Dr Spider MD pet.
Merry is a baby yeti companion pet available from the Christmas Spirit Shop for 3,000 Christmas Spirit.
Miner's journal #1 is a journal obtained from killing Ripper Demons.
Players do not have to be on a Slayer assignment to obtain this journal.
Misthalin crossbow is a two-handed ranged weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 33 of the premier Yak to Basics event.
Necromancy XP lamp is a reward item given upon completion of the Tomes of the Warlock quest.
The new key is obtained during the Mourning's End Part II quest by talking to the Head mourner in the basement of the Mourner Headquarters in West Ardougne.
If dropped, another can be found on the desk in the south-east room of the basement.
The kratonite knife is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
The ogre gate key is obtained from Grish toward the end of the quest Zogre Flesh Eaters to gain entrance to the Ogre's ceremonial chamber in Jiggig.
The disk is used on an abstract mural downstairs in his house in order to obtain a vase lid needed to complete Peer's challenge.

Pharaoh's shendyt (brown).x: The brown pharaoh's shendyt is part of the pharaoh's outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: It can be obtained from Hofuthand at the Grand Exchange in Varrock.
Pinchy is a pet that can be purchased for 5 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 30 of Yak to Basics and was later available for a time from the Marketplace for 5,000 oddments.
Grey pirate leggings can be looted from pirate implings.
A platinum anklet is a piece of platinum jewellery made by crafting a platinum bar and a dragonstone with level 109 Crafting at any furnace.
This is the highest level item that can be made with a dragonstone.

Rageful Cape.x: The Rageful Cape is a back slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Rageful Armour set.

Reforged Saradomin Gauntlets.x: Reforged Saradomin Gauntlets is a hands slot cosmetic override that is part of the Reforged Saradomin Armour.

Replica Barrows (Torag) Platelegs.x: The Replica Barrows (Torag) Platelegs are a legs slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Replica Barrows (Torag) outfit.

sc: The Replica Helm of Neitiznot is a head slot cosmetic override that is obtained by opening the giant present on the Christmas Village from 25 December 2023.

Currently, they can be obtained by members as a rare drop from Armadyleans in the God Wars Dungeon.
XP lamp is a reward obtained upon completion of Azzanadra's Quest.
An XP lamp (tier 2) can be obtained from a chest in Zamorak's hideout (accessible with the communication device) after completion of the quest Dishonour among Thieves.
The lamp may be rubbed to obtain 50,000 experience in any skill (25,000 experience in Invention).
Additionally, an yellow feather headdress can be created by adding 20 yellow feathers to a studded leather coif with level 79 Crafting.
It is drop from the golden warbler bird caught using the Hunter skill.
